svg.title: 晏銘湛箴溫潤色卡
svg.desc: Locked 雲箋 and 陶土 colors, dark derivatives, neutrals, and the unconfirmed 深藤紫 proposal. Hex values come from wenrun-design-system v7.1 tokens.css. Sticker, cover, and emblem colors are not included.
